map.按发货单量与仓储成本计算单均仓储成本与万单成本。: Compute the warehousing cost per order and per ten thousand orders from the shipment count and warehousing cost.
map.📖 查看「物流（发货/仓储/供应链）整合 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Logistics (Shipping / Warehousing / Supply Chain) Consolidation Guide"
map.本工具按发货量、仓储周转与履约时效计算物流整合成本与时效，辅助供应链协同与仓网优: This tool computes logistics consolidation cost and timeliness from shipment volume, warehouse turnover and fulfilment lead time, supporting supply chain coordination and warehouse network optimisation.
map.💡 单均仓储成本 = 仓储成本 ÷ 发货单量；万单成本 = 单均成本 × 100: 💡 Warehousing cost per order = warehousing cost ÷ shipments; cost per ten thousand orders = per-order cost × 10000; used to assess the value of integrated warehousing and delivery.
map.📚 深度解析：物流（发货/仓储/供应链）整合: 📚 In-depth Analysis: Logistics (Shipping / Warehousing / Supply Chain) Consolidation
map.仓网优化：录入各仓覆盖与成本，比单仓与分仓的总履约成本。: Warehouse network optimisation: enter each warehouse's coverage and cost to compare the total fulfilment cost of a single warehouse against distributed warehouses.
map.时效评估：录入发货到签收时长，算平均与达标率。: Timeliness assessment: enter the time from dispatch to delivery to compute the average and the on-target rate.
map.教学演示：演示分仓就近发货降时效与运费。: Classroom demo: shipping from the nearest warehouse cuts both lead time and freight.
map.示例：单仓发全国均 3.5 天、运费占比 8%；前置分仓后均 2 天、运费 6%: Example: a single warehouse shipping nationwide averages 3.5 days with freight at 8%; with forward warehouses it averages 2 days and freight 6%, cutting both time and cost.
map.分仓降时效但增仓租与库存，高动销区前置才划算，低动销反而增成本。结果仅供电商运营: Distributed warehouses cut lead time but add rent and inventory, so it pays off only in high-velocity regions and raises costs where sales are slow. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.库存周转=销货成本/平均库存，越高资金效率越高，但过低有断货风险。结果仅供电商运: Inventory turnover = cost of goods sold / average inventory; a higher figure means better capital efficiency, though too low a stock level risks stockouts. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.多系统(OMS/WMS/TMS)数据打通与一致是关键，否则口径不一难优化。结果仅: Connecting and aligning data across OMS, WMS and TMS systems is the key, since inconsistent definitions make optimisation difficult. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
